        15                  As we have just celebrated Memorial

        17       Senator Maziarz, to explain his vote.

        18                  SENATOR MAZIARZ:    Thank you very

        19       much, Madam President.

        20                  This is the -- I think a two-week

        21       extender to the Power for Jobs program, a very

        22       valuable program.  It provides low-cost

        23       hydropower produced at Niagara and

        24       St. Lawrence to almost 500 businesses in

        25       New York State.



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                                         4680



         1                  And we in this Senate, there's one

         2       thing -- after a day like yesterday -- I think

         3       we could truly point to with a great deal of

         4       pride, that we in the Senate have worked

         5       together, both sides of the aisle, to come up

         6       with what the people in business, the people

         7       in labor, the people in the field of energy

         8       all agree is a very good compromise.

         9                  It protects those industries that

        10       currently get an allocation of Power for Jobs;

        11       it expands the pool of companies in New York,

        12       particularly manufacturing companies, that

        13       will be eligible for Power for Jobs; it

        14       protects upstate residential ratepayers in the

        15       three utility districts -- National Grid,

        16       RG&E, and New York State Gas and Electric.

        17       And we did this in a very professional,

        18       bipartisan manner here.

        19                  The real problem is not in this

        20       house but over in the other house, where they

        21       just can't seem to negotiate, they don't want

        22       to, it appears to me, to negotiate any kind of

        23       a final agreement.  They just want to keep

        24       extending and extending and extending.

        25                  So I think that we clearly should



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                                         4681



         1       do this for those almost 500 businesses.  But

         2       I do think that we have to draw a line

         3       somewhere and say that we are not going to go

         4       any further with this.

         5                  So, Madam President, I vote in the

         6       affirmative.  Thank you.

         7                  ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS:

         8       Senator Maziarz to be recorded in the

         9       affirmative.

        10                  Senator Griffo, to explain his

        11       vote.

        12                  SENATOR GRIFFO:    Thank you,

        13       Madam President.

        14                  I agree with Senator Maziarz, and I

        15       do believe that we are working very hard in

        16       this house to try and find common ground.

        17                  In fact, in the first Energy

        18       Committee that we began to discuss the

        19       possibility of a short-term extender, I warned

        20       that it should be a longer version of that,

        21       because if we only go in these two-week

        22       increments that we're going to see problems,

        23       particularly in the other house.

        24                  I'm also concerned about the

        25       Governor and his position.  There's some



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                                         4682



         1       indication that there may be an unwillingness

         2       to sign any extender.  And I would hope that

         3       he would not jeopardize all of these important

         4       manufacturers who are relying upon this.  And

         5       when we're at a time when we are concerned

         6       about jobs and the future of our economy, I

         7       would hope that he would continue to support

         8       this as we try to work on a product and a

         9       final bill that will bring Power for Jobs into

        10       a permanent policy.

        11                  So I will be voting yes today, and

        12       I'm hopeful that we can get everybody to

        13       continue to be focused and supportive of the

        14       initiative of Power for Jobs in a permanent

        15       perspective.

        22                  I also am going to vote aye on this

        23       bill, but there's a point that I made before

        24       and I just want to reemphasize it, is there's

        25       just so much power that's being allocated for



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                                         4683



         1       jobs.  There's a limited number of kilowatts,

         2       and we've got to use it most effectively.

         3                  And the most effective way to use

         4       this is by assisting manufacturing companies,

         5       those that provide the greatest, the best

         6       jobs.  They also provide the spinoffs for

         7       other companies that do business for the

         8       manufacturing companies.

         9                  And I would hope that as the

        10       negotiations go forward that we restrict the

        11       eligibility to manufacturing companies, as

        12       opposed to arts organizations or nonprofit

        13       organizations or universities and the like.  I

        14       just don't think that with the limited amount

        15       of power that we should not use it for the

        16       biggest bang for the buck; namely,

        17       manufacturers.  So I vote aye with that

        18       understanding.

        19                  Thank you, Madam President.

         1       thank you.
